description: Bilingual FR/EN Sudoku solver, generator and tutor — PyQt6 desktop app

items: Fast solver: bitmask constraint propagation + MRV backtracking
HumanSolver: 8 techniques (naked/hidden singles, naked pair/triple, hidden pair, pointing pair, box/line reduction, X-Wing)
Generator: 4 difficulty levels with symmetric clue removal + unique-solution check
PyQt6 GUI: interactive 9x9 grid, pencil marks, hint overlay, bilingual FR/EN
Logo generated by Pillow (radial gradient + sudoku grid motif)
LaTeX techniques guide (bilingual, 6 pages)
launch.bat + launch.sh (NAS-portable venv in %APPDATA%/$XDG_DATA_HOME)
Crash handler with anonymised JSON reports

v1.1.0.summary: Full audit: perf, anti-crash, anti-freeze, security
items: SolveWorker QThread: solving runs off the UI thread
Solver max_nodes=2,000,000 cap to bound pathological input
_guarded decorator: try/except + showMessage on every action handler
launch.bat rewritten: scan explicit Python paths, avoid Store alias, py -3 fallback, venv validation
generate_logo.py: radial background optimized with Pillow Image.composite (8s → 0.26s)
i18n.py: replaced deprecated locale.getdefaultlocale() with locale.getlocale() + env vars
MAX_PUZZLE_FILE_BYTES=10KB cap on file open
Rotating log handler (100KB, 2 backups)
Fix @_guarded: use inspect.signature() to truncate extra positional args from Qt signals (QPushButton.clicked(bool), QAction.triggered(bool))

Fix worker lifecycle: _on_gen_worker_finished / _on_solve_worker_finished clear self.gen_worker/self.solve_worker BEFORE deleteLater() — no more 'wrapped C++ object has been deleted' on repeated New-puzzle clicks
_worker_is_running() helper catches RuntimeError on dead wrappers
New user manual manuel.pdf (15 pages, bilingual) — Part I English + Part II Français cleanly separated
README: Robustness section added

core.sudoku/board.py: Board class: 81-cell array + 9-bit candidate bitmasks, peer tables
core.sudoku/solver.py: Fast solver: propagation + MRV backtracking, max_nodes cap, SolveResult dataclass
core.sudoku/techniques.py: 8 technique finders + HumanSolver + bilingual Step explanations
core.sudoku/generator.py: Difficulty enum + Generator with symmetric hole-digging + uniqueness check

gui.gui/grid_widget.py: Interactive 9x9 QWidget with paintEvent, candidate display, hint overlay

architecture.i18n: i18n.py — auto-detect via locale.getlocale() + env vars, T() accessor, set_language/get_language

launchers.launch.bat: Windows: scan paths, py -3 fallback, venv in %APPDATA%/SudokuSolver/venv, --repair mode

docs.manuel.tex / manuel.pdf: User manual: Part I English + Part II Français (15 pages)

known_limitations: Generator may retry up to 40 times then fall back to closest difficulty match (rare on Expert)
Imported puzzles needing techniques beyond X-Wing fall back to backtracking for the hint engine
No auto-update mechanism yet (unlike Kevin's other desktop apps)

Save/load game with timer for user progression tracking
